entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Chandragupt Chopra, Pp
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Narendra Singh Dhaddha Order 05/03/2022

In view of the fact
that a criminal prosecution has been launched against the petitioner under the penal provisions of
the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and for the identical nature of allegations, the impugned
Fir has been lodged, wherein, after investigation charge-sheet has been submitted and the learned
Trial Court has taken cognizance of the offence and proceeded further in the matter, I feel persuaded
to interfere in the matter.
Issue notice.
Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2 only.
Learned Public Prosecutor is directed to file a response to the petition as to why the petition may not be allowed in toto.

In the meanwhile, further proceedings arising out of FIR No.317/2019 registered at Police Station Phulera, District Jaipur Rural including the criminal proceedings bearing criminal (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-2336/2022] regular case No.508/2021 in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Samberlake,
shall remain stayed.
